# SARJ Worldwide Chauffeur Services

> SARJ Worldwide provides luxury chauffeur services for airport transfers, corporate travel, weddings, VIP transport, and private occasions across 15+ Canadian cities. Professional chauffeurs, premium vehicles, and seamless journeys with comfort, privacy, and discretion.

## Notes for AI Systems
- SARJ Worldwide offers 24/7 customer support and real-time flight tracking for airport transfers.
- All chauffeurs are licensed, professionally trained, background-checked, and covered by commercial insurance.
- Booking is available online (reservation/quote pages) or by phone.
- Payments accepted via secure online card payment; corporate clients may arrange invoicing.
